channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Veterans’ memorial plaques in Tustin stolen; Long Beach man arrested
item.description: Police say the suspect is linked to bronze plaque thefts at Veterans’ Sports Park in Tustin and other memorial sites across Orange County.

item.title: Calabasas ridgetop house shaped like an X seeks $13 million
item.description: Recognized with the 2025 award for residential design, the distinctive two-story residence spans 8,953 square feet.

item.title: Orange County scores and player stats for Friday, Feb. 13
item.description: Scores and stats from Orange County games on Friday, Feb. 13

item.title: NBA All-Star Celebrity Game: Rome Flynn repeats as MVP, Team Giannis wins
item.description: The actor/model scores 17 points as Team Giannis beats Team Anthony, 65-58, in a game that brought basketball back to the Forum for the first time in years. Former NBA player Tacko Fall scores 20 points for the losing side.

item.title: Sunny Hills boys soccer slips a goal past El Toro to advance in playoffs
item.description: Forward Brandon Netzahual scores in the 28th minute and Sunny Hills records another shutout as it advances to the CIF-SS quarterfinals.

item.title: Sierra Vista holds off Estancia to advance to boys soccer quarterfinals
item.description: Francisco Ramirez scores in the 45th minute to help Sierra Vista earn a spot in the CIF-SS Division 4 quarterfinals.

item.title: San Juan Hills girls water polo cooled off by Glendora in CIF-SS quarterfinals
item.description: Roundup: San Juan Hills loses Friday in the CIF-SS Division 3 quarterfinals. Northwood and Laguna Hills advance to the semifinals.

item.title: 76ers’ VJ Edgecombe leads Team Vince to Rising Stars title, shares Abdul-Jabbar moment
item.description: The 20-year-old guard, who was named Rising Stars MVP after a 17-point semifinal effort and his game-winning free throws in the final, says meeting basketball icon Kareem Abdul-Jabbar is his All-Star Weekend highlight.

item.title: Aliso Niguel boys basketball shoots its way to victory over Glendora
item.description: Aliso Niguel’s 3-point shooting propels it to a win in the second round of the CIF-SS Division 3 playoffs.

item.title: Corona del Mar boys basketball can’t keep up with Crespi in Open Division
item.description: Corona del Mar has trouble with Crespi's size advantage and loses for just the second time this season. The Sea Kings have another tough matchup next week in the CIF-SS playoffs.
